labels.rationale: The text explicitly writes 'التامينات الاجتماعية' (GOSI, missing hamza), the registry's own name for the system, and compares its mobile e-services with the reviewed app's, so it counts as a named mention.
'اتركو توكلنا' ('leave Tawakkalna') names the app as the thing to drop, which is a pun on the next phrase 'متوكلين على الله'; the first توكلنا is the app name, not the religious phrase.
Absher, Watani and Kollona Amn are each written after 'تطبيق' (app) and listed as government apps, so 'تطبيق وطني' names the Watani app rather than meaning 'national'.
In the list of apps 'توكلنا وطمني وصحتي', 'طمني' is a spelling variant of Tetamman (تطمن) with the conjunction و attached, alongside Tawakkalna and Sehhaty used as app names.
'ممتاز كلنا امن' praises Kollona Amn by name (missing hamza) in a review; the patriotic phrase that follows does not make the opening reference a plain slogan.
